| `qc.timeout` | dur | `5s` |  | no |  |  | How long one call to Jev may take. |

- **`qc.jev`**: Whether the code of a change is sent to Jev to be judged (the second tier). It leaves this machine, so it is yours to turn on: Settings › All › qc.jev.
- **`qc.provenance`**: Say how sure an edge is. The callers, tests, look-alikes and file map Jev is sent are matches of words, and with this on the state says `~lexical` for them and a verdict that picks among look-alikes is shown with it. Off, Jev is sent what it always was.
- **`qc.skip`**: Patterns to leave out, by id, separated by commas (`rs-fmt, todo-left`). A pattern you never want to hear about is left out here; it is not deleted.

## reflexes

| Setting | Type | Default | Words | Live | Shown | Follows | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reflexes.cap_usd` | num | `0.25` | 0.0–100.0 | yes |  |  | The most the judge of the reflexes may cost in a day, in dollars; past it no reflex fires until tomorrow, and the Log says so. |
| `reflexes.judge` | bool | `false` |  | yes |  |  | Whether the judge of the reflexes may be sent the digest of this project (the numbers of /context, the heads of the last turns, the reflex's sentence, all redacted, as kit.judge). |
| `reflexes.on` | bool | `false` |  | no |  |  | Check the reflexes that are on at each settled point, and run the ones that hold. |
| `reflexes.trust` | int | `5` | 1–1000 | yes |  |  | How many of the judge's calls must have held, none overridden, before a reflex that throws context away (`:compact`, `:fresh`) stops asking the operator and runs by itself (the trust record: a yes is a call that held, a no one that was overridden). |

- **`reflexes.cap_usd`**: The most the judge of the reflexes may cost in a day, in dollars; past it no reflex fires until tomorrow, and the Log says so. A call whose price the judge did not say counts as one cent.
- **`reflexes.judge`**: Whether the judge of the reflexes may be sent the digest of this project (the numbers of /context, the heads of the last turns, the reflex's sentence, all redacted, as kit.judge). `off` (the default): nothing is sent, and a reflex whose check holds does not fire; the Log says so. Set it per project, when its text may go to Jev. Needs reflexes.on.
- **`reflexes.on`**: On: the reflexes that are on are checked, at a settled boundary only (never in the middle of a turn), and when a check holds one decision model is asked, from a digest made by code, whether the operator's sentence is true; if it says yes the command runs, and the Log says why (`rule.fired`, or `reflex.checked` with the judge's reason). Off (the default): nothing is checked, nothing is asked, nothing is written. A reflex never answers an approval and never widens what J4n may do. Read at the start.

## shape

| Setting | Type | Default | Words | Live | Shown | Follows | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `shape.format` | str | `auto` | list, plain, sections, xml, auto | no |  |  | How the kept rows are written for the doer: `list`, `plain`, `sections`, `xml`, or `auto` (the format a `shape_format` row names for the doer, else `list`). |
| `shape.judge` | str | `light:deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` |  | no |  |  | The judge, of another family than the shaper, in the same form; `off` for none. |
| `shape.max_notes_tokens` | int | `120` | 40–400 | no |  |  | The most the notes may come to, measured as characters divided by four. |
| `shape.model` | str | `light:anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5` |  | no |  |  | The shaper: a doer, a colon and the model it is asked for (`light:anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5`, `light` is the small model of the pack jev, on your OpenRouter key). |
| `shape.on` | bool | `false` |  | yes |  |  | Shape each line before it goes to the agent. |
| `shape.skip` | str | (empty) |  | no |  |  | Lines that are never shaped, whole and apart from case, separated by commas (a short reply such as `continue` is never shaped anyway). |
| `shape.style` | str | `notes` | notes, rewrite | no |  |  | `notes` adds sourced notes under the line; `rewrite` also offers a clean version of it (the typed line always goes with it). |
| `shape.timeout` | dur | `3s` |  | no |  |  | How long the shaper and the judge are each given to answer. |
| `shape.tone` | str | `keep` | keep, plain, brief, detailed | no |  |  | For `rewrite`: `keep` fixes typos and grammar only, `plain`, `brief` or `detailed` also reword. |
| `shape.words` | str | (empty) |  | no |  |  | Your own instruction to the shaper, for example `always name the test command`. |

- **`shape.model`**: The shaper: a doer, a colon and the model it is asked for (`light:anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5`, `light` is the small model of the pack jev, on your OpenRouter key). With no such doer, shape says `not run` and why, and lines go as typed.

## skills

| Setting | Type | Default | Words | Live | Shown | Follows | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `skills.max` | int | `3` | 0–8 | yes |  |  | The most skills a task is given. |
| `skills.off` | str | (empty) |  | yes |  |  | The skills that are switched off, by name, with a comma between (`:skill off j4n-docs`). |
| `skills.pick` | bool | `true` |  | yes |  |  | Whether J4n gives a task the few skills that fit it: `true` (the default) picks by the line's words, the files it names and the kind of task, locally, with no model, and puts only those in that doer's brief (a folder of its own for claude); `false` gives none. |
| `skills.tokens` | int | `1200` | 0–20000 | yes |  |  | The most tokens the skills of a task come to together (a skill's `cost`); one that does not fit is left out. |

- **`skills.off`**: The skills that are switched off, by name, with a comma between (`:skill off j4n-docs`). A skill that is off is never picked.
